about.text: A yoghurt named after Silivri, Istanbul, made in industrial or semi-industrial dairies from cow, sheep or buffalo milk, or mixes of these. The milk is pasteurised at 90 to 95 °C for 30 minutes, then incubated at 42 to 45 °C for 2 to 3 hours.

sources.text: The method and the dairies, from the entry.
